text: and I'm running for State Assembly because California needs a fighter who is an experienced leader when the stakes are high. I'm the only candidate in this race with a proven record of creating jobs, lowering costs, tackling crises, reducing crime, and improving public safety.

I'm proud to be endorsed by:
- Los Angeles County Firefighters
- Sheriff Robert Luna and law enforcement leaders
- California Nurses Association
- Planned Parenthood Central Coast Action Fund
- State Senator Henry Stern
- Assemblywoman Jacqui Irwin

I was elected to the Agoura Hills City Council just two days before the Woolsey Fire. I helped lead recovery efforts, improve emergency preparedness, cut red tape, and make our neighborhoods safer and more resilient.

strong: As we face more extreme wildfires, rising costs, and a home insurance crisis, we need leadership that has been tested.

text: I grew up here, raised my children here, and have spent my career fighting to make this region stronger. As Chair of Clean Power Alliance, I helped create thousands of good-paying jobs, lower energy costs, and expand clean energy. I've strengthened local schools,
and delivered results by bringing people to the table.
As a working mom determined to help residents afford to live here, I will stand up to Trump to make California more affordable.

strong: I'll focus on reducing the high cost of healthcare, prescription drugs, energy, housing, food, and gas.

text: I'm ready to deliver on day one, and I'd be honored to earn your vote.
